mapper.insert: INSERT INTO channel_product_price_coefficient ( id, camp_id, room_category_id, channel_id, product_name, operator_type, coefficient_value, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{campId}, #{roomCategoryId}, #{channelId}, #{productName}, #{operator}, #{coefficientValue}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE operator_type = VALUES(operator_type), coefficient_value = VALUES(coefficient_value), updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO room_price_snapshot ( id, camp_id, poi_id, room_category_id, biz_date, price_type, channel_id, price_cent, currency, status, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{id}, rc.camp_id, rc.poi_id, rc.room_category_id, #{bizDate}, 'central', 0, COALESCE(rc.weekday_price_cent, 0), 'CNY', #{snapshotStatus}, NOW(), NOW() FROM room_category rc WHERE rc.camp_id = #{campId} AND rc.room_category_id = #{roomCategoryId} AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE price_cent = VALUES(price_cent), status = VALUES(status), updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO room_price_snapshot ( id, camp_id, poi_id, room_category_id, biz_date, price_type, channel_id, price_cent, currency, status, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{id}, rc.camp_id, rc.poi_id, rc.room_category_id, #{bizDate}, 'channel', #{channelId}, #{priceCent}, 'CNY', 'active', NOW(), NOW() FROM room_category rc WHERE rc.camp_id = #{campId} AND rc.room_category_id = #{roomCategoryId} AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM room_price_snapshot existing WHERE existing.camp_id = rc.camp_id AND existing.room_category_id = rc.room_category_id AND existing.biz_date = #{bizDate} AND existing.price_type = 'channel' AND existing.channel_id = #{channelId} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE price_cent = VALUES(price_cent), status = VALUES(status), updated_at = NOW()
